hypotheses.hypothesis: Estimated camera, lighting and display scale solely explain the apparent macro/source-construction mismatch; completed-target rejection is a false rejection.
hypotheses.test_capable_of_proving_objection_wrong: Inspect original controlling locked full-bird and July head pixels, high-resolution candidate head/detail/profile, eight viewpoints under neutral and workshop light, and actual saved browser neutral/exhibit views. The sole-explanation objection fails if source-specific construction landmarks remain absent or simplified in multiple camera/light/scale conditions. Compare before/after camera/light metadata to rule out presentation changes as the cause of local09 changes.
tests_performed: Direct original source and full-size head pixels inspected with view_image
Direct whole, profile, neutral/workshop eight-angle and saved desktop browser pixels inspected
All-three-era before09/after09 camera/light/render metadata compared; result attached
hypotheses.evidence_status: analytical visual judgment over live-rehashed frozen images
findings: Camera/depth uncertainty survives: exact source proportion, depth, stance and compactness measurements are not established. Candidate/source camera is estimated, not calibrated. Do not turn a subjective compactness impression into a precise measured defect.

Lighting strongly changes highlight brightness, but the candidate bill remains two large relatively smooth plates, the cheek has sparse smooth bars, and the crown remains a broad smooth cap. The controlling sources have visibly nested plates/fasteners, layered crown construction and denser mapped surface articulation. These differences remain in close-up and alternate fixed views; changing display scale or lighting alone does not supply those landmarks.

The warm hood hue has some source support in the July brow and is not inherently a color failure. Its broad pale dominance, smoothness and shape differ from the source. This qualification weakens overbroad color-only criticism but does not remove the construction failure.
Rear cavity is directly visible in candidate/browser orbit. Exact unseen source rear construction remains unknown; the source cannot support a prescriptive hidden rear shape.
Independent of this artistic test, owner artistic acceptance remains absent under the frozen contract, so camera plausibility could not alone establish completed C00.
hypotheses.release_effect: No completed-target reopening toward approval. Narrow any exact-ratio/camera-based claims; retain supported visible construction mismatch.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combined09 gains are erased by interacting regressions, so even the limited mixed review-study usability should be rejected.
hypotheses.test_capable_of_proving_objection_wrong: Compare exact same-camera receiving06 and integrated09 whole/head images across all eras, then inspect source head/full bird and candidate profile/eight/browser views. If a localized source-specific improvement remains readable at whole scale and the packet exposes the mixed regressions instead of concealing them, the stronger study-usability rejection fails. A blanket net-gain/all-module-retention claim would require the combined whole bird to improve against canon without material competing regression; it cannot be proved merely by regional scores.
tests_performed: Three-era source/before/candidate whole contact comparison directly inspected
Matched receiving06/candidate09 full-size head pixels directly inspected
Known-limit wording in README, selected-modules, claim ledger and criteria inspected
hypotheses.result: failed for rejecting limited study usability; net whole-character gain remains unknown/provisional
hypotheses.evidence_status: analytical visual judgment over live-rehashed frozen images
findings: The reduced recessed Advanced optic is visibly more plausible than the receiving06 flat oversized concentric ring, and remains readable amber at native/browser whole scale. This localized gain survives combined09.

Connected throat/breast courses replace the earlier disconnected small scales and are visibly coherent, but the elongated broad smoother lower panels and pale hood still compete with the denser source character. Sparse bill/cheek construction and substantial toe/foot-source differences remain. Not every changed region can be called a source-specific gain.

The pale crown cap dominates candidate whole views and differs from the source focal hierarchy. This is a surviving visible limitation; warm hue alone is not proof of regression because source brow metal is also warm.

The review packet explicitly declares posterior crown, simplified cheek/bill, regular optic, nonzero lower tip burial, rear/talon bulk and lost far-grazing optic peeks. The inspected views disclose the unresolved construction. Mixed gains do not destroy the usefulness of an honestly labeled comparison study.

No observation proves combined09 has a positive net whole-character source-likeness change or justifies retaining every module. C01 and CLM09-05 should remain provisional/disputed at that stronger scope. Neither majority agreement nor this failed counterexample closes them.
hypotheses.release_effect: Keep approve-with-limits solely for editable mixed development review. Do not reinterpret it as net whole-character likeness acceptance or automatic retention of HEAD17/BILL18/BODY15/FEET14.
